question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: implement power train finance change generate earn work migrate find Bangladesh has an agro based economy. The farmers are the main (a) ⎯⎯ of this economy. There are many poor and landless farmers. They don't have income (b) ⎯⎯ projects to work on. Govt. and some NGOs are (c) ⎯⎯ some projects for our rural development and poverty alleviation. Our unemployed youth should have (d) ⎯⎯ for self employment. They should be helped and (e) ⎯⎯ for fish cultivationor and other activities for earning. The trend of (f) ⎯⎯ to the towns or cities should be (g) ⎯⎯. There should be venues in the rural areas where the unemployed people will (h) ⎯⎯ employment to (i) ⎯⎯ their living. The govt. and the NGO's should (j) ⎯⎯ jointly for this purpose.
guide_solution: (a) power (b) generating (c) implementing (d) been financed (e) trained (f) migrating (g) changed (h) have (i) earn (j) work
